cues.en: Bitcoin has won over some of America's best known billionaires,
cues.zh: 比特币已经赢得了美国一些知名亿万富翁的青睐，

cues.en: and institutions worldwide are treating it as a serious financial asset. But price is only one part of the story. Whether they know it or not, people who buy Bitcoin are strengthening a tool for protecting human rights. This still relatively new form of electronic money is censorship resistant, seizure resistant, borderless, permissionless, pseudonymous, programmable, and peer to peer. In Bitcoin, transactions don't go through banks or financial intermediaries.
cues.zh: 全球各大机构也正把它当作一种正经的金融资产来看待。但价格只是故事的一部分。无论他们是否意识到，购买比特币的人都在强化一个保护人权的工具。这种相对较新的电子货币形式具备抗审查、抗没收、无国界、无需许可、假名化、可编程以及点对点的特性。在比特币网络中，交易无需经过银行或金融中介。

cues.en: They travel directly from one person to another. Payment processing is done not by a regulated company like Visa or Mastercard, but by a decentralized global software network. Storage is handled not by a bank, but by the users themselves.
cues.zh: 它们直接从一个人转移到另一个人。支付处理不是由 Visa 或 Mastercard 这样的受监管公司完成，而是由一个去中心化的全球软件网络完成。存储不是由银行处理，而是由用户自己处理。

cues.en: Bitcoin issuance isn't determined by central bankers. The currency's creator, Satoshi Nakamoto,
cues.zh: 比特币的发行不是由央行官员决定的。这种货币的创造者中本聪，

cues.en: set it to have an ultimate limit of 21,000,000.
cues.zh: 将其设定为最终上限 2100 万枚。

cues.en: No one can ever print more. Bitcoin transactions can't be stopped, and you don't need to reveal your name or address or telephone number to participate.
cues.zh: 任何人都无法再增发。比特币交易无法被阻止，而且你无需透露姓名、地址或电话号码即可参与。

cues.en: You just need Internet access.
cues.zh: 你只需要能上网。

cues.en: In 2017, the economist Paul Krugman described Bitcoin as some fancy technological thing that nobody really understands.
cues.zh: 2017 年，经济学家保罗·克鲁格曼把比特币说成一种花哨的技术玩意儿，没人真正懂它。

cues.en: There's been no demonstration yet that it actually is helpful in conducting economic transactions.
cues.zh: 目前还没有证据表明，比特币在经济交易中确实有用。

cues.en: There's no anchor for its value.
cues.zh: 它的价值没有锚定物。

cues.en: Krugman lives in a sheltered environment in a liberal democracy with constitutional protections.
cues.zh: 克鲁格曼生活在一个受宪法保障的自由民主社会，环境安逸。

cues.en: His native currency is globally dominant and relatively stable. It's easy for him to open a bank account, to use a mobile app to pay bills, or to grow his wealth by investing in real estate or stocks.
cues.zh: 他的本国货币在全球占主导地位，而且相对稳定。对他来说，开银行账户、用手机应用支付账单，或投资房地产和股票来积累财富，都很容易。

cues.en: But most people don't have the same privilege. 4,200,000,000
cues.zh: 但大多数人没有这样的特权。42亿人

cues.en: live under authoritarian regimes that use money as a tool for surveillance and state control.
cues.zh: 生活在专制政权之下，金钱被用作监控和国家控制的工具。

cues.en: Their currency is often debased, and they are, for the most part, cut off from the international system that Krugman enjoys. For them, saving and transacting outside the government's purview isn't shady business. It's a way to preserve their freedoms.
cues.zh: 他们的货币往往不断贬值，而且大多被排除在克鲁格曼所享有的国际体系之外。对他们来说，在政府监管范围之外储蓄和交易并非见不得人的勾当，而是守住自由的一种方式。

cues.en: In China, if you type or utter one wrong word, the Communist Party might eliminate your financial services. This devastating outcome creates a chilling effect for dissidents and creative minds who are forced to use the country's increasingly centralized digital economy. In Hong Kong or Russia, donors to human rights organizations can get their bank accounts suspended and funds seized. Over the past few months in Belarus and Nigeria, nationwide protests have broken out against tyranny and corruption. In both places, activists raising money to support the democracy movement have had their bank accounts frozen. And as we saw in Burma just a few days ago, the military shut down the banking system during their latest coup and turned off the ATMs.
cues.zh: 在中国，哪怕只是打错或说错一个字，当局就可能切断你的金融服务。这种毁灭性的打击，给被迫使用该国日益中心化数字经济的异见人士和创意工作者带来了寒蝉效应。在香港或俄罗斯，为人权组织捐款可能导致银行账户被暂停、资金被冻结。过去几个月里，白俄罗斯和尼日利亚爆发了抗议暴政与腐败的全国性抗议。在这两个国家，为民主运动募资的活动人士，其银行账户都被冻结了。正如几天前我们在缅甸看到的那样，军方在最近的政变中直接关停了银行系统，并关闭了自动取款机。

cues.en: For activists living under state repression, Bitcoin provides a way to preserve their money in cyberspace,
cues.zh: 对于生活在国家镇压下的活动人士来说，比特币提供了一种在赛博空间保存资金的方式，

cues.en: locked away by encryption, safe from devaluation in a network that has never been hacked.
cues.zh: 经加密锁定，免受贬值影响，置身于一个从未被攻破的网络中。

cues.en: For them, it's digital cash and digital gold rolled into one.
cues.zh: 对他们而言，这是数字现金与数字黄金的合二为一。

cues.en: And in Cuba, Nigeria, China, Pakistan, Venezuela,
cues.zh: 在古巴、尼日利亚、中国、巴基斯坦、委内瑞拉、

cues.en: Russia, Turkey, Argentina, Palestine, Zimbabwe, and elsewhere, Bitcoin is catching on and helping people escape tyranny and currency collapse.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯、土耳其、阿根廷、巴勒斯坦、津巴布韦等地，比特币正流行起来，帮助人们逃离暴政与货币崩溃。

cues.en: In the past few months, Belarusian activists have used Bitcoin to defy the regime by sending more than $3,000,000
cues.zh: 在过去几个月里，白俄罗斯的活动家们利用比特币反抗政权，发送了超过300万美元

cues.en: of unstoppable money directly to striking workers, who then convert it locally to rubles in peer to peer marketplaces to feed their families as they protest the country's dictatorship.
cues.zh: 这笔无法被冻结的资金直接交到了罢工工人手中，他们随后在点对点市场上将其兑换成卢布，在抗议该国独裁统治的同时养家糊口。

cues.en: In October, a feminist coalition in Nigeria raised the equivalent of tens of thousands of dollars in Bitcoin to buy gas masks and protest equipment as activist bank accounts were being turned on and off. In Russia, the politician and activist Alexei Navalny has raised millions in Bitcoin in opposition to Vladimir Putin, who has strict control over the traditional financial system. Putin can do a lot of things, but he can't freeze a Bitcoin account. In Iran and Palestine and Cuba, citizens are increasingly able to escape foreign restrictions on their financial rights, thanks to Bitcoin.
cues.zh: 今年10月，尼日利亚的一个女权联盟筹集了价值数万美元的比特币，用于在活动家的银行账户被随意冻结解冻时购买防毒面具和抗议装备。在俄罗斯，政治家兼活动家 Alexei Navalny 筹集了数百万美元的比特币来反对 Vladimir Putin，后者对传统金融体系有着严密的控制。Putin 能做很多事，但他无法冻结比特币账户。在伊朗、巴勒斯坦和古巴，多亏了比特币，民众越来越有能力摆脱外部对其金融权利的限制。

cues.en: In these places, individuals are dealing with sanctions or embargoes placed on them because of the misdeeds of their corrupt rulers.
cues.zh: 在这些地方，人们因为腐败统治者的不法行为而受到制裁或禁运的影响。

cues.en: Bitcoin gives them a lifeline for earning income or receiving remittances from abroad.
cues.zh: 比特币为他们提供了一线生机，让他们能够赚钱或接收来自海外的汇款。

cues.en: Some Venezuelans, having watched their country's currency evaporate due to hyperinflation,
cues.zh: 一些委内瑞拉人眼看着本国货币因恶性通货膨胀而贬值殆尽，

cues.en: are converting their time and energy and family resources to Bitcoin's digital format and then escaping.
cues.zh: 便把自己的时间、精力和家庭资源转化为比特币这种数字资产，然后逃离家园。

cues.en: With their savings secured by a password that can be stored on a flash drive, phone, or even memorized, they've started new lives in other countries, taking advantage of a technology that refugees throughout history could only dream about. The citizens of democracies also face financial controls, deplatforming,
cues.zh: 只要把积蓄靠一个密码保护起来，存在U盘、手机里甚至记在脑子里，他们就能在其他国家开始新生活，利用这项历史上难民梦寐以求的技术。民主国家的公民也面临着金融管制、封号下架，

cues.en: and an ever expanding surveillance state.
cues.zh: 以及不断扩张的监控国家。

cues.en: But those lucky enough to live in open societies can vote, sue, protest, and write, and those methods might allow them to protect their financial freedom and privacy.
cues.zh: 但那些有幸生活在开放社会的人，可以通过投票、起诉、抗议和写作来发声，这些途径或许能让他们捍卫自己的财务自由和隐私。

cues.en: The billions who live under authoritarian governments don't have the same options. Unlike democracy,
cues.zh: 生活在威权政府下的数十亿人没有同样的选择。与民主不同，

cues.en: Bitcoin is universally available. You don't need to have a particular passport or bank card or voting status to use it. No government can turn off your Bitcoin if it's threatened by your ideas.
cues.zh: 比特币是普遍可用的。你不需要特定的护照、银行卡或投票身份就能使用它。如果你的思想让它受到威胁，没有政府能关掉你的比特币。

cues.en: We are in the middle of a great digital transformation,
cues.zh: 我们正处在一场伟大的数字变革之中，

cues.en: a time when cash, one of the last bastions of privacy and freedom, is disappearing.
cues.zh: 这个时代，现金——隐私与自由最后的堡垒之一——正在消失。

cues.en: People are increasingly relying on easily surveilled apps like Apple Pay, Alipay, and perhaps soon, central bank digital currencies as their primary medium of exchange.
cues.zh: 人们正日益依赖 Apple Pay、支付宝，甚至可能很快还会依赖央行数字货币等极易被监控的应用，作为主要交易媒介。

cues.en: Bitcoin provides an alternative to our increasingly centralized financial system. It gives any activist or journalist a way to raise funds without censorship,
cues.zh: 比特币为我们日趋中心化的金融体系提供了一种替代方案。它为所有活动家或记者提供了一种免受审查的筹资途径，

cues.en: a way to save despite the corrosive impact of excessive money printing, and a way to teleport value without permission.
cues.zh: 一种抵御滥发货币侵蚀的储蓄方式，以及一种无需许可即可瞬间转移价值的手段。

cues.en: Bitcoin wasn't as powerful five years ago before it had global liquidity.
cues.zh: 五年前，比特币还没有全球流动性，影响力远不如今天。

cues.en: But today, exchanges have popped up in every region. Daily trading volume exceeds that of popular stocks like Apple, and peer to peer marketplaces like Paxful and LocalBitcoins have extended their reach,
cues.zh: 但如今，每个地区都涌现出交易所。比特币的日交易量超过了苹果等热门股票，Paxful 和 LocalBitcoins 这样的点对点交易平台也拓展了业务范围，

cues.en: enabling users to sell Bitcoin for local currency almost anywhere in the world.
cues.zh: 让用户几乎在世界任何地方都能把比特币兑换成当地货币。

cues.en: Maybe you don't need Bitcoin, and maybe you don't understand Bitcoin, and maybe PayPal, Venmo, or your bank account serve your needs just fine. But don't write off Bitcoin as simply a vehicle for financial speculation.
cues.zh: 也许你不需要比特币，也许你不懂比特币，也许 PayPal、Venmo 或你的银行账户已经完全满足你的需求。但别把比特币简单地看成一种金融投机工具。

cues.en: For millions of people around the world, it's an escape hatch from tyranny and nothing less than freedom money.
cues.zh: 对全世界数百万人来说，它是逃离暴政的安全出口，更是名副其实的自由货币。
